0.0: Next, we'll work on bolstering your attack power. Yes, you'll learn many exciting skills in your time here, but your attack power is the bread and butter of your arsenal of abilities! Ooh, now I'm hungry!

yes.0: Go to #b#m310010200##k and dismantle #r20 #o9300410# units#k. However, be wary. These are not your average robots.
yes.1: You see, #r#o9300410# units#k are programmed to self-destruct. They will explode exactly 10 seconds after you attack them, so you must defeat them quickly if you care for your limbs. Your task is to defeat 40 of them BEFORE they self-destruct. Are you up to the challenge?

no.0: Resistance members must be unyielding in their commitment! Perhaps you aren't quite ready yet.

1.0: You defeated the #o9300410# units, without a thorough toasting? Superb! Let's move on to the next challenge.

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r20 #o9300410# units#k? Don't feel bad. Few ever get everything right on their first try!
